scope: SQLite WAL/SHM sidecar terminology in status and doctor outputs
reported_issue: Valid DBs could report normal WAL/SHM files under orphan_sidecars.

changes.summary: DbPreflightReport now includes sqlite_sidecars and sidecar_status; orphan_sidecars remains only as a deprecated compatibility field and is populated only when the main DB is missing.
CLI status and doctor now expose consistent sqlite_sidecars and sidecar_status fields.
MCP status now exposes consistent sqlite_sidecars and sidecar_status fields.

tests.name: status_and_doctor_report_normal_sqlite_sidecars_for_valid_db
tests.coverage: Valid DB with live WAL/SHM sidecars reports sidecar_status=normal in status and doctor.

tests.name: status_and_doctor_report_orphan_without_main_db_for_sidecars_only
tests.coverage: WAL/SHM files without a main DB report sidecar_status=orphan_without_main_db in status and doctor.
